result.summary: Fixes a timing bug in `interface_ipc_mining.py` where a large `--timeout-factor` caused test failure, and speeds up normal test execution by reducing unnecessary sleep intervals. It also clarifies variable units by renaming `default_ipc_timeout` to `default_ipc_timeout_ms`.
result.problem: When running tests with a large `--timeout-factor`, the IPC call in `interface_ipc_mining.py` timed out before a delayed `generate()` call finished, resulting in `template2` being `None` and an assertion failure. Additionally, normal test runs spent unnecessary time sleeping longer than needed.
evidence: PR description: 'The test would fail with a large enough timeout factor, because the ipc times out before the delayed generate() call: template2 would be None and fail the assert.'
PR description: 'Also, the test would sleep more than timeout_factor seconds in the happy case in all test runs.'
result.scope_notes: Small functional test timing fix spanning a single test file.
result.card: This PR fixes a bug in interface_ipc_mining.py that causes test failures when running with a large timeout factor, and speeds up the test by reducing unnecessarily long sleeps. Under large timeout factors, IPC requests would time out before a delayed block generation occurred, producing an assertion failure. It replaces the sleep logic to wait just longer than a fee tick and clarifies millisecond unit naming. The change only affects a single functional test.

risk.why: A mistake would only cause the IPC mining functional test to fail or flake in CI.
